newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NatFoods sees strong export growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NatFoods sees strong export growth.

text.p: National Foods Ltd said on Thursday it expects strong export growth over the coming years in its beverage and specialised food ingredients products.
National Foods managing director Max Ould said the opportunities to expand internationally on an equity participation basis will be approached cautiously.

"Relationships with international partners will be pursued and we expect strong growth over the coming years with beverage exports and specialised food ingredients," Ould told shareholders at the annual meeting.
"It is, however, unlikely this will be a primary profit driver for the company in the near-term," Ould said.
He said the company was undertaking a review of some of its assets.

"Throughout our business activities we are undertaking a critical review of what I term our 'lazy assets', those that can be of greater value to someone else or can be merged into existing and duplicated activities," Ould said.
He said attention would be focused on ensuring the delivery of an appropriate return on the asset base of the company.
